name: camphor (synthetic) + menthol + white petrolatum
purpose: Purpose External analgesic External analgesic Skin protectant
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with minor cuts, scrapes, insect bites, and minor skin irritations (e.g. chafed nose) Temporarily protects minor cuts and scrapes Helps prevent, relieve, and temporarily protect chafed, chapped, or cracked skin and lips Helps prevent and protect from the drying effects of wind and cold weather
otcwarn: Do not use on: deep or puncture wounds animal bites serious burns If condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days, discontinue use of this product and consult a physician
